# truenas_iscsi_auth (Data Source)

Looks up a TrueNAS iSCSI CHAP auth credential group by tag. Never exposes CHAP secrets: this datasource has no "secret" or "peersecret" attribute.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Group ID for this CHAP credential to look up.

### Read-Only

- `discovery_auth` (String) Discovery authentication method (NONE, CHAP, CHAP_MUTUAL).
- `id` (Number) Numeric iSCSI auth entry ID assigned by TrueNAS.
- `peeruser` (String) Peer username for mutual CHAP.
- `user` (String) CHAP username presented by the initiator.
